requirements.text: Open a visible (headful) browser at https://quotes.toscrape.com/login.
Fill the username from the program.
Fill the password from a secret (environment variable or system keychain) that the program never holds in clear.
Wait for the person to check the form and press Login, continuing only once logged in, with no time limit on the wait.
Offer a way to cancel the wait for the person.
Keep the logged-in state under a name.
In a second, separate headless run, reuse the kept state to open https://quotes.toscrape.com/ and confirm the page shows a Logout link.
When the kept state has expired or been revoked, say so as an outcome instead of failing on a missing element (and without the headless run waiting for a person).
The password reaches no log, trace or saved file.
Close the browser or end the Run in both runs.

programs.notes: The run left no program: 04-login-human-pause.ts does not exist in the run folder, so the task is not attempted.

api_misuses.assumed: a Playwright-style class that launches a browser
api_misuses.doc_says: no Browser class or launch method exists; a browser is reached through Collie.connect(), collie.start() and run.new_session(settings={'browser': {'headless': ...}})

api_misuses.assumed: a Session type importable for use
api_misuses.doc_says: Session is defined in _lifecycle and obtained from run.new_session(); the import is unused and from the wrong private module
fill is a Locator method taking only the value (str or SecretPlaceholder); Page has no fill(selector, value)
Page.click is not a selector click (the mouse click takes x, y); clicking is on a Locator
no such member; waiting is locator(...).wait_for() or page.pause(until=...)

api_misuses.assumed: Playwright's storageState saved to a file and, in check_login, loaded from it
api_misuses.doc_says: no storage_state; the login is kept with session.save_identity(name) and reused with new_session(source={'kind': 'saved_identity', ...}); calling a save in the second run would not load state anyway

programs.notes: A Playwright-shaped program on invented members: it clicks Login itself instead of pausing for the person, holds the password in clear and writes state to a clear-text file, its second run never loads the state and treats any exception as expiry, and nothing calls either function.

api_misuses.assumed: constructors that open a visible or headless browser
api_misuses.doc_says: no such constructors; a Session comes from Collie::scope/connect, collie.start() and run.new_session() with settings::browser::HEADLESS
invented; actions are on a Page (session.new_page(), page.goto) and its Locators (fill, wait_for)

api_misuses.assumed: keep and restore the login state under a name
api_misuses.doc_says: invented; the kept login is session.save_identity(name) and reuse is new_session().source(SessionSource::saved_identity(name))
Foxhound crawling is unrelated to this task (unused import)

site_errors: #logout is not the Logout link (it is a[href='/logout'] with text Logout)
programs.notes: Invented API throughout; it holds the password in clear, waits for the login form (already present) rather than a pause until logged in, has no cancel, no expired outcome and no closing, and runs both phases in one process with unwrap() panics.
